title: 杜德利25基点不够：市场已定价3到4次加息，美联储还得加多少？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: The former New York Fed president, Bill Dudley, writing a 25 basis point hike is too small to have a meaningful impact on economic activity.
segments.zh: 前纽约联储主席杜德利撰文指出，25个基点的加息幅度太小，难以对经济活动产生实质性影响。

segments.en: Bill joins us now for more. But welcome to the program, before this decision in your column, you said the case for a hike was crystal clear.
segments.zh: 比尔现在加入我们深入讨论。欢迎来到节目，在此次决策前，您在专栏中表示加息的理由非常明确。

segments.en: Is the case for another hike just as clear? Right now it is, unless the data change is pretty dramatically, it can work basically said that he needs to make financial conditions less accommodate, probably push them into
segments.zh: 再次加息的理由同样明确吗？目前来看是的，除非数据出现显著变化。基本上可以说，他需要让金融条件不再那么宽松，可能将其推向限制性区域。

segments.en: the respective side. And he hasn't told us how much you need to do to do that, but judging by the reaction of financial markets, he hasn't really accomplished that yet.
segments.zh: 他并未说明需要做到何种程度，但从金融市场反应来看，他尚未真正实现这一目标。

segments.en: I think that, you know, he also signaled that this is probably the first in a series by talking about removing a dose of accommodation that implies that there's more doses to remove
segments.zh: 我认为，他还暗示这可能是系列行动的第一步，提到要减少一剂宽松，意味着后续还有更多剂需要撤出。

segments.en: forthcoming. And if you look at what the federal funds futures market is pricing, and they're pricing in three or four hikes over the next, you know, over the next six to nine months.
segments.zh: 如果看联邦基金期货市场的定价，未来六到九个月内已计入三到四次加息。

segments.en: So the market certainly expects that the Fed's not done, and that makes sense.
segments.zh: 因此市场显然预期美联储尚未完成加息，这合情合理。

segments.en: If financial conditions are accommodative, that's causing the economy to grow in an unsustainable pace.
segments.zh: 如果金融条件宽松，导致经济以不可持续的速度增长。

segments.en: You need to do more to make financial conditions less accommodative to a restrained economic activity.
segments.zh: 你需要采取更多措施，使金融条件不再那么宽松，以抑制经济活动。

segments.en: You know, what's interesting about the Fed's forecast is serve the immaculate disinflation.
segments.zh: 美联储预测中有趣的一点是，似乎假设了完美的反通胀。

segments.en: If you look at the summer of economic projections, growth doesn't slow, unemployment rate doesn't rise yet.
segments.zh: 如果看夏季的经济预测，增长并未放缓，失业率也尚未上升。

segments.en: Inflation magically, it sinks back to two percent. I think it's going to be a little bit harder than that.
segments.zh: 通胀却神奇地回落到2%。我认为实际情况会更难一些。

segments.en: Bill, do you think we need the demand destruction?
segments.zh: 比尔，你认为我们需要破坏需求吗？
